results.title: Tariff Guide
results.content:
Currently, China faces many trade remedies, including Section 301 duties on most products from China, Section 232 duties on steel and aluminum, IEEPA duties on all goods from China, automotive duties on all automobiles and most automotive parts, and reciprocal tariffs.

Where can I find the executive orders or proclamations the President signs? [...] Are the reciprocal tariffs additive with other trade remedies?

The reciprocal tariffs do not apply if the good falls under Section 232 for either steel & aluminum or the automotive tariffs. There are also further exemptions, such as copper, pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, lumber articles, certain critical minerals, and energy and energy products, listed under Annex II. Goods covered under future trade remedies are also excluded from the reciprocal tariffs. [...] Are the Section 232 tariffs (automotive and steel and aluminum) additive with other trade remedies?

They are additive with all trade remedies except the reciprocal tariffs. If the Section 232 automotive tariffs apply, the reciprocal tariffs do not apply.
